cross_group_synergies.bridge_mechanism: Mana generation cards provide the necessary mana to activate card draw and mana utilization cards, creating a continuous cycle of card draw and mana generation.

Runaway Steam-Kin.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a red spell, if this creature has fewer than three +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
Remove three +1/+1 counters from this creature: Add {R}{R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin.summary: Gains +1/+1 counters when red spells are cast and can produce three red mana by removing three +1/+1 counters.

Whispers of the Muse.oracle_text:
Buyback {5} (You may pay an additional {5} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Draw a card.
Whispers of the Muse.summary: Draw a card and optionally return the spell to your hand for an additional {5} cost.

Ingenious Mastery.oracle_text:
You may pay {2}{U} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{U} cost was paid, you draw three cards, then an opponent creates two Treasure tokens and they scry 2. If that cost wasn't paid, you draw X cards.
Ingenious Mastery.summary: Allows paying {2}{U} to draw three cards and create two Treasure tokens, or draw X cards if the alternative cost is not used.

Tezzeret's Gambit.oracle_text:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
Draw two cards, then proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

Daze.oracle_text:
You may return an Island you control to its owner's hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.
Daze.summary: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.

Reiterate.oracle_text:
Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Copy target instant or sorcery spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
Reiterate.summary: Copy target instant or sorcery spell and optionally return this card to hand with buyback.

Muddle the Mixture.oracle_text:
Counter target instant or sorcery spell.
Transmute {1}{U}{U} ({1}{U}{U}, Discard this card: Search your library for a card with the same mana value as this card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Transmute only as a sorcery.)
Muddle the Mixture.summary: Counters a target instant or sorcery spell and has a transmute ability to search for a card with the same mana value.

Fervent Mastery.oracle_text:
You may pay {2}{R}{R} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{R}{R} cost was paid, an opponent discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
Search your library for up to three cards, put them into your hand, shuffle, then discard three cards at random.
Fervent Mastery.summary: Allows paying an alternative cost to draw and discard cards, and search for up to three cards to put into hand and then discard three random cards.
